name: parakeet-unified-v5 (fine-tuned) + GPU-PB biasing on clean_eval_v2 (Arm D)
short_description: Arm D of the t0026 2x2 ablation: the fine-tuned parakeet-unified-v5 checkpoint decoded with malsd_batch and GPU-PB context biasing (context_score=3.0, depth_scaling=0.5, alpha=1.5) on the 91-clip clean_eval_v2 holdout.
model_description: nvidia/parakeet-unified-en-0.6b fine-tuned on 422 Rezolve domain clips (encoder frozen, decoder+CTC head only) — the DVC-tracked checkpoint archived at tasks/t0024_parakeet_unified_checkpoint_archive/assets/model/parakeet-unified-v5/ (loaded here via NeMo's ASRModel.restore_from). Decoding uses malsd_batch beam search with a GPU-PB boosting tree stacked on top of this fine-tuned checkpoint (context_score=3.0, depth_scaling=0.5, alpha=1.5) — the Pareto-frontier cell selected on the base model by the prior task t0024_biasing_pareto_and_ft_biasing_ablation, applied here unchanged via boosting.apply_malsd_boost rather than re-swept.
prediction_schema: Each line is a JSON object with fields: clip_id (string, unique clip identifier), ref (string, ground-truth reference transcript), hyp (string, model hypothesis transcript), brand (string "Rezolve"/"brainpowa" or null for neutral clips), label (string "EXACT"/"PHONETIC"/"GARBAGE" or null for neutral clips), wer (float, per-clip word error rate), latency_seconds (float, per-clip inference latency), source (string, "quepasa_prod" or "clean_eval_21" indicating clip provenance).

files.description: Per-clip predictions for all 91 clean_eval_v2 clips (43 brand-containing, 48 neutral) from the fine-tuned parakeet-unified-v5 checkpoint decoded with malsd_batch + GPU-PB context biasing (Arm D of the t0026 2x2 ablation).
